ranked_evidence.title: 2019 Indian general election - Wikipedia
ranked_evidence.snippet: # 2019 Indian general election. General elections were held in India in seven phases from 11 April to 19 May 2019 to elect the members of the 17th Lok Sabha. The Bharatiya Janata Party won in a landslide receiving 37% of the vote, the highest vote share by a political party since the 1989 general election, and winning 303 seats, further increasing its substantial majority. The Indian National Congress won 52 seats, failing to get 10% of the seats needed to claim the post of Leader of the Opposition. Legislative assembly elections in the states of Andhra Pradesh, Arunachal Pradesh, Odisha and Sikkim were held simultaneously with the general election, as well as by-elections of twenty-two seats of the Tamil Nadu Legislative Assembly. In Bihar, Uttar Pradesh and West Bengal, the election was held in all seven phases. | Jammu and Kashmir | *6* | 2 | 2 | 1⁄3 | 1⁄3 | 11⁄3 |.
